I have farmed this shamba near Dar es Salaam for many years using the ways my father and grandfather taught me, since I never went to school. I do not use chemical fertilizers because they cost too much and I cannot read the instructions on the bag, but I always spread plenty of manure from my cattle and goats on the soil before planting. I keep my own seeds from last season and plant them mixed together in intercropping, as we have always done. My wife and children will work this plot with me most days of the season, and I will hire two young men from the village for about two weeks when the weeds are heavy and during harvest time.
